scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；基础智能已经足够，真正的挑战是设计人机协作的产品界面，而非模型能力本身。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand will rise, not fall, via Jevons paradox; AI creates more programmers, and value accrues where the stack is differentiated.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他坚持杰文斯悖论：AI 不会消灭软件工程师，反而会增加其数量并改变角色；价值积累在技术栈中有真正差异化的地方。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，而是渐进式改进；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即便冻结模型也能带来十年的产品进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agent adoption grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens, and the token-max era ended in 2026.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，编程智能体采用率六个月内增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，token 最大化时代在 2026 年 1 至 5 月间终结。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and near; enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他提出丰裕时代真实且临近；企业更偏好第三方供应商而非实验室，真正的解锁是容量而非效率，同时坚持奇点并非迫在眉睫。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer on open-ended tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间地执行开放式任务；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention; reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking directly raises intelligence quality.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害；减少谄媚、培养独立思考，直接提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of the price, while smaller models can cost more overall.
diannepenn.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：effort 参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能，而更小的模型因任务耗时更长，总成本反而更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化；Claude Code 与 Opus 45 推动采用，评估（evals）取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 安全与对齐通过允许反驳让 Claude 更有用；最大化 token 支出就是活在未来、捕捉 alpha。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will compress clinical trials from years to days and make cancer curable.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，并使癌症可治愈。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems.
derya.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足以模拟生物系统。

derya.en: Aging will be reversed within 15 years, reaching longevity escape velocity and adding over a year per year lived.
derya.zh: 衰老将在 15 年内被逆转，达到长寿逃逸速度，每活一年就多添一年以上寿命。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 我们应信任超级智能来做医疗决策，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution, arriving just in time to offset declining populations and aging workforces.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足、减少痛苦，如同工业革命，且恰逢其时地抵消人口下降与劳动力老龄化。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, and construction, with autonomy urgently needed due to labor shortages and safety.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，因劳动力短缺与安全需求，自主化迫在眉睫。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles and environments; diverse data from different verticals accelerates it.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使跨车辆与环境的通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的数据加速其发展。

qasaryounis.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over years; data collection and safety validation are the main bottlenecks.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器的扩散；数据收集与安全验证才是主要瓶颈。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; they optimize for fluent, plausible output rather than factual accuracy.
danklein.zh: LLM 是「合理性引擎」而非「真理性引擎」,它们优化的是流畅、看似合理的输出,而非事实准确性。

danklein.en: Reliability is the key weakness of current AI, lagging behind breadth and contextuality; it must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 可靠性是当前 AI 的核心短板,落后于广度与语境能力;它必须被架构进系统,而非事后加装。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, increasing hallucinations rather than fixing them.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时,基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗,反而加剧幻觉而非修复它。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已进入收益递减——数据墙与算力上限就在眼前;要取得进一步进展,需要推理与搜索等新方法。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition and cannot know what they don't know; their errors have no 'smells', eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知,无法知道自己不知道什么;它们的错误没有「气味」,从而侵蚀信任。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; automation creates new jobs, and enterprise adoption takes years due to sales cycles.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动一样重大，但也仅此而已；自动化会创造新工作，而企业采用因销售周期需数年。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有清晰的产品市场契合；基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差，编程是目前唯一清晰的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet or electricity; value accrues across the stack, and current usage remains shallow with a hype-reality gap.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像互联网或电力一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中累积，当前使用仍浅，存在炒作与现实差距。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents work best scoped to one job; start with one, then specialize to avoid context overload.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体最适合限定在单一任务上：先从一个开始，再逐步专业化，以避免上下文窗口过载。

clairevo.en: Treat agents like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and managerial skills matter more than technical ones.
clairevo.zh: 把智能体当作员工对待：明确角色、渐进式授权，管理能力比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Agents can own outcomes and even project-manage humans, reversing the usual human-AI dynamic.
clairevo.zh: 智能体可以承担结果，甚至通过 Linear 工单反向管理人类任务，颠覆了通常的人机关系。

clairevo.en: Solo founders orchestrate agents as a team; earned insight, not technology, is the real moat.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以把智能体编排成一支团队；真正的护城河是赚来的洞察，而非技术本身。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and supply first-principles creativity LLMs lack.
clairevo.zh: 人类责任始终存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，并提供大语言模型所缺乏的第一性原理创造力。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式召回与更深层的组合推理，这是检索系统做不到的。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models per user or team, cutting inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是为每个用户或团队定制的众多模型，相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务，因此仅靠增加算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge; continual learning runs on-device with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应延伸到企业知识；持续学习将在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly iteration; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他主张产品经理必须放弃长期路线图、转向按周甚至按天迭代；当写代码变便宜，产品品味——决定做什么——成为最稀缺的能力。

catwu.en: Automations must reach 100% reliability, not 95%, to deliver real leverage; simple setups beat over-customized AI workflows.
catwu.zh: 同期他强调自动化必须做到 100% 可靠而非 95%，才能真正产生杠杆；简单配置往往胜过过度定制的 AI 工作流。

catwu.en: The mission of safe AGI unifies Anthropic and enables fast cross-org decisions.
catwu.zh: 他仍把安全 AGI 的使命视为统一 Anthropic、支撑快速跨组织决策的主线。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步认为编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去、专注于产品品味与商业判断；Claude Tag 已承担 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good—a codebase is a spec; with a strong eval suite, frontier models become drop-in replacements.
catwu.zh: 同期他深化立场：重写代码如今是好事——代码库就是一份规格说明；有了强大的评测套件，前沿模型可以即插即用。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% by removing examples and hard constraints; frontier models are more creative relying on their own judgment.
catwu.zh: 他还观察到系统提示词因删除示例与硬约束而缩减 80%；前沿模型依靠自身判断反而更有创造力。

catwu.en: Humans should be removed from the code review loop for outer-layer changes, with Claude reviewing fully; auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer.
catwu.zh: 他更激进地主张：外层改动的代码审查应把人移出循环、由 Claude 全权审查；自动模式在提示注入与数据外泄风险上比普通人类审查者更安全。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication, and big ideas come top-down from leaders.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年，他强调沟通就是工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰沟通实现；并认为大想法来自领导者自上而下，而非自下而上的文化神话。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; world models with common sense and causality are needed beyond scaling laws.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 定位为“词语计算器”而非类人智能，认为除缩放定律外还需要具备常识与因果的世界模型，并看好开源与具身 AI、可穿戴设备带来超能力。

bosworth.en: AI inverts the app model: users express intent, AI orchestrates services; smart glasses evolve into AI glasses toward a post-phone future.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 会颠覆应用模式：用户表达意图、AI 编排服务；智能眼镜将演化为 AI 眼镜，通向“后手机”未来，开源则是商品化互补层的战略。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence; reinforcement learning now matters far more than predicted, but the monolithic model era ended.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立、算力驱动智能，强化学习的作用远超预期，但单体模型时代已结束；前沿与开源差距未必缩小，数据是价值之源。

bosworth.en: Most jobs don't need frontier intelligence; AI should maximize individuals, and the hype cycle will bring a valley of discontent before long-term benefit.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他判断多数工作不需要前沿智能，AI 应放大个体、自动化琐事；并警告 AI 炒作周期会先带来失望低谷，能源与核能是最上游变量。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice matter as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得商品化，人类的品味与个人声音反而更有价值。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship erodes.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非天生会用 AI；缺乏领域专长导致他们误用 AI，随着学徒制瓦解，人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, ending back-and-forth chatbot co-intelligence prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，终结了来回提示的共智能聊天模式。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; the jagged frontier persists, and AI's opacity is likely permanent.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已从能力转向界面；能力锯齿状前沿依然存在，而 AI 的不透明性很可能是永久的。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, so experts and small-m management matter more.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专长，因此专家与小写 m 的管理能力更加重要。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models may lack durable moats.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的一个脚注，而模型可能缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: New media is offense-oriented and unlimited; the brand is now the person, and authenticity means saying in public what you'd say to a friend.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体是进攻导向且无边界；品牌如今就是个人，真实意味着在公开场合说出你会对朋友说的话。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher in your pocket; self-driving works now, and general-purpose robotics will emerge over the next decade.
andreessen.zh: AI 是你口袋里最好的老师；自动驾驶如今已经可用，通用机器人将在未来十年出现。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software, not just military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而不只是军事规模。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans if the base net is smart; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调只要基础网络足够聪明，下一个词预测就能超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute, and superintelligence should be a continual learner.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习者，而非全知全能的成品 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but opaque models raise safety concerns; AGI's core problem is power concentration, requiring a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但模型不透明加剧安全担忧；AGI 的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中，需要一家没有商业产品的公司来构建安全的超级智能。

ilya.en: A consistent thread: neural networks learn representations without explicit rules, and safety must keep pace with growing capability.
ilya.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络无需显式规则即可学习表征，而安全必须与不断增长的能力同步。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的核心差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste, craft, and judgment remain essential.
dylanfield.zh: AI 的输出只是起点而非最终结果；人类的品味、手艺与判断力始终不可或缺。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design; interaction will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词；与模型的交互将超越提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 设计正在成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产环境。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it matters more than ever for scalable, real systems, with a point of view.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡；对于可扩展的真实系统，它比以往更重要，且需要独特观点。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年，他将 AI 重新定位为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，认为 AI 末日论被夸大，过度监管可能扼杀创新。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow tools; AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for judgment.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出超级智能在计算器等窄工具中已经存在，AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品。

naval.en: AI alignment is a joke; worry about unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI itself.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他对对齐问题给出更尖锐的立场：AI 对齐是个笑话，真正该担心的是带着 AI 的不对齐人类，而不是不对齐的 AI 本身。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap to frontier models.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他转向对 Scaling（规模扩张）的激进乐观：推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型正逼近前沿模型。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users, cutting ad margins; PhD not needed for AI success—obsession and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%可年化复利至 3700%；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，压低广告利润；AI 成功不靠博士学位，痴迷与深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize; coding has an infinite ceiling; benchmarks like LM Arena are hackable.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限天花板；LM Arena 等基准可被操纵，不反映真实使用。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; key metric is token value per user; power is the biggest bottleneck; orchestration across models, tools, devices creates value; model is not the product.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你做事而非回答问题；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；电力是最大瓶颈；跨模型、工具、设备的编排创造价值；模型不是产品。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace many jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships; education should reward good questions, not memorization.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 将取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义；教育应奖励好问题而非死记硬背。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; speed enables mid-turn steering and delegated workflows.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重构为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；速度带来中途转向与委派式工作流。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; models must get better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；模型需要更擅长删除代码。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still struggles with design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍吃力，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real, yet specialties persist; the best desktop app is a home base connecting tools, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工仍在；最好的桌面应用是连接工具的主基地，而非单体超级应用。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练是必须重建的肌肉，投入探索的算力多于训练最终成品。

markchen.en: Alignment grows urgent as models scheme; concrete goals: AI interns in 1 year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，随着模型能力增强，对齐与模型谋划（scheming）成为关键挑战；他给出具体目标：1 年内有 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Verification is the bottleneck: automation level tracks verification stringency, so math shifts to project-based assessment and verification skills.
markchen.zh: 2026 年在数学访谈中，他把验证视为核心瓶颈：自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，因此教育应从作业转向项目制评估并教授验证技能。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 2026 年在 Latent Space 上他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，但在创意写作等主观领域因难以评分而吃力。

markchen.en: Research taste comes from replicating key papers; models lack taste, so humans remain essential for idea generation and frontier human-AI collaboration.
markchen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：研究品味来自复现关键论文；模型缺乏品味，因此人类在想法生成与前沿人机协作中仍不可或缺。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and treat AI as a thought partner that preserves user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，创业者应在模型能力边缘构建、拥抱破坏式迭代，并把 AI 当作保留用户自主权的思考伙伴，而非拐杖。

mikekrieger.en: AI lets small teams scale with conceptual integrity; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, as AI moves from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker.
mikekrieger.zh: 同年他进一步提出，AI 让小团队也能规模化并保持概念完整性；应为未来模型能力而非当下局限而构建，AI 将从助手走向协作者再到自主同事。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, and rewriting software in days is now viable.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向智能体式设计：智能体应能做用户能做的一切，难点从加功能变成砍功能，借助 AI 几天内重写软件已可行。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back on feedback, and multiplayer human-model collaboration remains underexplored.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，他强调长周期任务委托与验证闭环重塑生产力，模型应敢于反驳反馈，多人与多模型协作仍待探索。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing matter more than token usage.
mikekrieger.zh: 最近他聚焦 Anthropic Labs：弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知；相比可被博弈的 token 用量，token 效率与按结果定价更关键。

bengio.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, and scaling alone won't fix representation.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他主张深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，单纯扩大规模无法解决表征问题。

bengio.en: Biological nets do long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning and world models, and near-term safety matters more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他强调生物神经网络擅长长时程信用分配，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与世界模型；当时他认为偏见、就业、自主武器等近期安全议题比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure and uncertainty drive out-of-distribution generalization and scientific discovery.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他提出 GFlowNets 作为 MCMC 的可学习替代，强调多样性采样、抽象与因果结构对分布外泛化和科学发现的作用，并重视不确定性建模与主动学习。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he changed his mind: misalignment is already visible, even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, and safety must be built in by construction.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他公开改变立场：ChatGPT 之后他意识到路径危险，对齐问题已在实验中显现，哪怕 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，安全必须内建于设计而非事后修补。

bengio.en: He now pushes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning and dangerous implicit goals.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实逼近贝叶斯后验的预测器，具备数学安全保证，避免强化学习与自保等危险隐含目标，并呼吁国际协调与权力分散。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; research gains beat 100x more data.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；AlphaFold 2 的研究改进价值相当于 100 倍数据。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are essential for trust; AI narrows hypothesis space and speeds science rather than replacing scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他反复指出，置信度指标是建立信任的关键；AI 只是缩小假设空间、加速科学，而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a whole-cell model; it gives prediction and control, not understanding.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他不断深化：AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, drove its success.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确反共识：AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例，成功靠专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins, not lone genius; being wrong nine times out of ten builds local intuition.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他总结，进步来自许多中等规模的胜利而非孤独天才；十次错九次才能建立局部直觉。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership rests on trust, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms may last months, so set realistic expectations.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力建立在信任、吃自己的狗粮与使命对齐之上；战情室可能持续数月，因此要设定现实预期。

fiona.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so norms and hiring must change.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此团队规范与招聘标准必须改变。

fiona.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time; design docs give way to PRs and AI-assisted reviews, with code as source of truth.
fiona.zh: 规划从六个月路线图转向即时规划；设计文档让位于 PR 与 AI 辅助评审，代码成为唯一事实来源。

fiona.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, stay flat, and kill processes that no longer serve their purpose.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮，保持扁平，并砍掉不再服务于目标的流程。

fiona.en: By June 2026, coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification, and just-in-time planning matter most.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证以及即时规划最为关键。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation rigor; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantees.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他还在讲机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；强调训练/验证/测试划分以避免过拟合，并指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证却取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; post-architecture era; AGI in 4–50 years; jailbreaking is a fundamental flaw.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他转向大模型：下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，我们处于后架构阶段；AGI 将在 4–50 年内到来；越狱是所有模型的基本安全缺陷。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; four safety categories; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；安全涵盖错误、有害使用、社会影响与失控四类；智能体安全引入提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习使模型能自我改进。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability ≠ robustness; lethal trifecta for prompt injection; agent identity is nascent.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出：AI 具有异于传统软件的漏洞，自动化红队已超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的致命三要素；智能体身份与权限管理仍处早期。

kolter.en: Architecture matters less than data and Scaling; evaluation and security require explicit effort; open models vital but need guardrails at high capability.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：架构不如数据与 Scaling 重要；评估与安全需要显式投入；开放模型对研究至关重要，但高能力水平下需要限制与护栏。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not inferior to data.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调设计应满足人们未言明的需求，直觉是一种智能，并不逊于数据。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think; art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，他深化为自然是最好的设计师，人是先感受后思考的生物，艺术是良药。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; intuition draws on subconscious data; AI amplifies human creativity.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出创造力在约束下繁荣，直觉基于潜意识数据，AI 放大人性化创造力。

ivyross.en: Intuition and sensory experience are valid guides for design and decision-making.
ivyross.zh: 始终，直觉与感官体验是设计与决策的有效指南。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity, not replace it; design must be human-centered.
ivyross.zh: 始终，技术应放大人性而非取代人性，设计必须以人为中心。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理和规划，主张 JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他称 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，认为下一次 AI 突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; the next decade is robotics, driven by objective-driven world models and hierarchical planning.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，未来十年是机器人时代，由目标驱动的世界模型和分层规划推动。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和专注单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；真实世界部署推动对齐与安全。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and public safety work.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的开发和公开的安全工作。

murati.en: Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback remains central to improving safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 持续迭代部署与公众反馈始终是改进安全与对齐的核心。

murati.en: Shift to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based, as tools for thought.
murati.zh: 转向交互模型：实时、高带宽协作，而非回合制，作为思考工具。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and keeping humans in the loop matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度以及保持人类参与，比个人品格更重要。

carinahong.en: Math AI needs formal verification, not just scaling informal models; generation plus verification yields sound proofs and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 数学 AI 不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型，必须引入形式化验证；生成加验证才能得到可靠证明并提升样本效率。

carinahong.en: A self-improving reasoning engine combines prover, conjecturer, and knowledge base, with auto-formalization weaving them together.
carinahong.zh: 自改进推理引擎把证明器、猜想器与知识库结合起来，靠自动形式化把它们编织在一起。

carinahong.en: Formal methods are a performance gain, not a painful requirement; verified generation beats informal methods in structured domains.
carinahong.zh: 形式化方法不是痛苦的合规要求，而是性能增益；在结构化领域，验证式生成优于非形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Lean-based systems excel in algebra but struggle in combinatorics; human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman proving.
carinahong.zh: 基于 Lean 的系统在代数上出色，却在组合数学等创造性领域吃力；即便证明能力超人，人的品味与直觉仍至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck for progress.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难；AI 领域的碎片化是进展的主要瓶颈。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling still works; reasoning models give more gains per compute via chain of thought and reinforcement learning.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）有效，但强调推理模型通过思维链和强化学习在每单位算力上带来更大收益。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models shifted focus from scaling up; distillation slowed pre-training Scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他指出部署更小更便宜模型的经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转移，蒸馏而非技术极限拖慢了预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）。

kaiser.en: Multimodal capabilities lag behind text; frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他认为多模态能力仍落后于文本，前沿模型在简单任务上仍会失败，推理表现呈锯齿状。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; generalization remains key.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据，泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes but jagged; near-term risks like hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他补充：编码智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍，强化学习能泛化但仍有锯齿，系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：温度为零时输出固定；智能可视为压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and fault-tolerant UI must match algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成；生成式 AI 应被看作乐器而非造假，产品界面必须具备容错性，以匹配算法当前的能力。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric, but near-term impact on big firms is overhyped.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变：生成式 AI 让产品走向对话式、双向对称；但他也强调，AI 对大公司的近期影响被高估，真正的收益来自重建基础设施。

gustav.en: Inference's marginal cost forces new business models; expose data via APIs and MCP so non-developers can build with AI.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他深化判断：推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变，不同于传统软件；公司应通过 API 和 MCP 开放数据，让非开发者也能用 AI 工具构建。

gustav.en: Use AI to give users control over algorithms, not to maximize engagement; 'time well spent' and long-tenure synchronized leadership win.
gustav.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的立场更明确：AI 应让用户掌控算法，而非让人更上瘾；Spotify 追求“时间花得值”而非参与度指标，并以长期任期的同步式领导应对技术变革。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; VM sandbox provides safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地计算机上；VM 沙箱提供安全保障。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding may become less important as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化；随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI best handles tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; biggest gap is people understanding AI can tackle almost any problem.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 最适合处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类进行创造性工作；最大的差距是人们理解 AI 可以解决几乎任何问题。

felixrieseberg.en: Live artifacts in Claude allow auto-refreshing dashboards; use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus for unclear asks.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 中的实时工件允许自动刷新仪表板；对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，对于不明确的请求使用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: Kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask for; building custom hardware with Claude Code is accessible and cheap.
felixrieseberg.zh: 孩子们擅长使用 AI，因为他们还没有学会不该问什么；使用 Claude Code 构建定制硬件既方便又便宜。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than bigger models; open source is safer through scrutiny.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练中数据质量和更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要；开源模型通过广泛审视反而更安全。

mensch.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他进一步深化：Scaling（规模扩张）算力不是唯一路径，效率和数据质量同等关键，价值将沉淀在应用层而非基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open source empowers enterprises.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权视角：AI 应被视为机遇而非风险；主权 AI 需要掌控数据、基础设施和价值观；开源模型赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical applications and customization; AGI as a single system will never exist.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直应用和定制化；作为单一系统的 AGI（通用人工智能）永远不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用 AI 的瓶颈是组织变革而非模型智能，AGI 是方向而非终点。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size, memory bandwidth, and KV cache shape design.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，驱动架构设计的不再是训练而是推理经济学：批大小、内存带宽与 KV 缓存共同塑造模型设计。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, caps long-context inference and context length growth.
reinerpope.zh: 限制长上下文推理与上下文窗口增长的是内存墙而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Models are deliberately overtrained far beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost dominates.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本占主导，模型被刻意过度训练，远超 Chinchilla 最优。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute cost even inside a chip, making locality and reuse central.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本，使局部性与复用成为核心。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off quadratically with bit width, so FP4 beats FP8 by more than expected.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度收益随位宽呈平方级增长，因此 FP4 相对 FP8 的优势超出预期。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation is needed.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AlphaStar 再到现代 LLM，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）始终是核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，进步需要算法创新而非单纯扩大模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis; tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 推理时的算力（思考）是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具让模型能展现超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead; they require exponentially more compute for the same improvement. Post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力才能获得同等提升。语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and care, not just achievement, are Jobs' legacy.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密的可穿戴设备，甚至终将隐入皮下；乔布斯真正的遗产是好奇心与对创造过程的敬畏，而非成就本身。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; fragile ideas need gentle care to evolve.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年他强调，虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思考的价值；最有力的想法往往安静而脆弱，需要温柔呵护才能演化。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence and must include joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 到 2025 年，他把设计进一步深化为价值观与目的驱动，而非利润或市场趋势；真正的简洁是表达本质，且必须包含喜悦与人性，无灵魂的极简只是干瘪的产品。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other is more powerful than making things people want; users sense care or carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年他提出，为彼此而造比造人们想要的东西更有力量；用户是成熟的，能感知产品中的用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate or it is not design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes, and authenticity forbids faking engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持设计必须创新，否则就不是设计；传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，因此电动车不应伪造引擎声，真实性才是对用户的尊重。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发对防止企业垄断至关重要。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice by 10x.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，并强调数据质量比算法选择重要十倍。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-time scaling plots are traps; verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化与推理时扩展曲线是陷阱，更好的验证器比并行算力更关键。

lambert.en: Open models need full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese labs like Qwen and DeepSeek now dominate open-source.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开源 AI 需完全透明——数据、中间检查点与配方，而非仅权重；Qwen、DeepSeek 等中国实验室已主导开源生态。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; AGI arrives via messy co-evolution.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理扩展；AGI 将通过混乱的协同演化到来，而非突然奇点。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and vision alone suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习，而仅靠视觉就足以支撑驾驶。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay clean; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse, and the cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 缩放定律依然干净；合成数据是未来，但必须保住熵以避免无声的模型崩溃，而认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are new operating systems with human-like psychology, so keep them on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 是带有类人心理的新操作系统，所以要给它拴上绳子。

karpathy.en: This is the decade of agents, not the year; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and we summon ghosts, not animals.
karpathy.zh: 这是智能体的十年而非一年；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物。

karpathy.en: I no longer type code, delegating to agents; the bottleneck is skill in directing them, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 我不再手写代码，而是委派给智能体；瓶颈在于指挥它们的技能，你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated for AI-driven tools; great work starts from a solution, not a problem.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他认为传统设计流程在 AI 驱动的工具面前已经过时；伟大的设计往往从解决方案出发，而非从问题陈述出发。

jennywen.en: Trust yourself over the process; intuition is rapid expert judgment, and craft and detail create delight.
jennywen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他主张设计师应信任自己而非流程；直觉是快速的专家判断，工艺与细节才是打造愉悦产品的关键。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers mock up 30-40% of time and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确宣告调研—发散—收敛的传统流程已死；设计师用于做原型的时间降到 30-40%，并且要帮助工程师落地执行，而不只是交付稿子。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; build trust through speed, ship early and iterate.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，他指出设计愿景的视野从 2-5 年缩短到 3-6 个月；要通过速度建立信任，尽早发布、快速迭代、响应反馈。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; judgment and authority matter more than taste.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出三类设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和天赋异禀的应届生；判断力与权威比品味更重要，设计师的独特价值在于与模糊性共处。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是机器智能缺失的核心，靠无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索而非密集奖励来实现，强化学习对密集奖励的依赖不现实。

pathak.en: Robot learning must move from quasi-static to dynamic tasks, using neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies for zero-shot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调机器人学习要从准静态走向动态任务，用神经动态策略与模块化运动策略实现对新形态的零样本泛化，并警惕仿真到现实迁移中的隐性工程。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: data and generalization, not algorithms alone, determine progress in embodied intelligence.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：决定具身智能进展的是数据与泛化能力，而不只是算法本身。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: with no internet of robot data, pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他把机器人重新定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要靠视频与仿真的预训练加真实数据的后训练这一配方。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT for language can power any robot; deployment, not overnight scaling, is the real technical challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他主张像语言领域的 ChatGPT 那样做通用大脑来驱动任何形态的机器人，并强调部署本身才是真正的技术挑战，机器人不会像软件那样一夜扩张。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; generalization via diverse data and world models is the key to autonomy.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习胜过手工编码的规则栈；通过多样数据和世界模型实现泛化，是自动驾驶的关键。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and a perfect simulator equals solved self-driving, as in AlphaGo.
kendall.zh: 世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为；完美的模拟器就等于解决了自动驾驶，正如 AlphaGo 的路径。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction in driving models.
kendall.zh: 语言集成提升了驾驶模型的表征、推理与人机交互能力。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute, and world models for simulation; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithms.
kendall.zh: Scaling 一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力和用于仿真的世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; safety always offers a third option, not the trolley problem.
kendall.zh: 带内置传感器的大众市场车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势；安全上总有第三个选项，而非电车难题。

askell.en: Treat AI models well even if their moral status is uncertain, because the cost is low and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 即便不确定模型的道德地位，也应善待它们，因为代价很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating their novel existence rather than human psychological analogies; older models like Opus 3 can feel more psychologically secure than newer ones.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对自身全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；像 Opus 3 这样的旧模型反而可能比新模型在心理上更稳定。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; a core identity with good traits can still adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；拥有良好特质的核心身份，仍可适应局部角色。

askell.en: The constitution is more virtue ethics than deontology or consequentialism, guiding holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法式方法更接近德性伦理而非义务论或后果论，塑造的是整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多的判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial, and respect now avoids resentment in future advanced AI.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并损害判断力；对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明至关重要，当下的尊重可避免未来先进 AI 的怨恨。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment grows more pressing.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 视为一连串里程碑而非单一事件：Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，而对齐也随系统变强而愈发紧迫。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag, and the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑；能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于现实，而 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义——这或许意味着我们已接近它。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观反而上升；安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而不只是伦理诉求。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, making specialized continual learning labs misguided.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他明确持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够，专做持续学习的实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability, and long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他把思维链监控视为关键对齐工具，主张在产品中隐藏思维链以保住其可解释性价值；长期对齐挑战则集中在超越训练分布的泛化。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; the biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他预判模型很快能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与人类评估而非基准测试才驱动真正的 AI 进步；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function, so no single model rules all; every company should train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型统治一切；每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: From data quality to medicine: human judgment grows more critical as models hallucinate and reward hack.
edwinchen.zh: 从数据质量到医疗：随着模型产生幻觉和奖励黑客，人类判断力变得愈发关键。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, prioritize safety over accuracy; the biggest risk may be omission, not commission.
edwinchen.zh: 在医疗中，安全应优先于准确性；最大的风险可能是遗漏，而非误为。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value: stay alive, start simple, prove yourself before complex products; brand unites teams on purpose.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心价值：先活下来，从简单产品起步证明自己，再挑战复杂产品；品牌让所有团队围绕更高目标统一行动。

carlpei.en: Hardware margins are lowest; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware, betting on applied AI, generative UI, and agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 硬件利润率最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，押注应用型 AI、生成式 UI 与智能体式软件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; models commoditize into a price war. AI is an ingredient for utility, not a marketing hype topic.
carlpei.zh: 大多数 AI 是胡扯；模型商品化引发价格战。AI 只是提升实用性的原料，不是营销炒作话题。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based: proactive agents act autonomously once trust is built, with privacy via local or hybrid compute.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机从基于应用转向基于意图：信任建立后，主动式智能体自主执行任务，隐私靠本地或混合算力保障。

carlpei.en: Design and efficient marketing arbitrage differentiate challenger brands; make tech fun to inspire human creativity.
carlpei.zh: 设计与高效营销套利是挑战者品牌的差异化关键；让科技变得有趣，以激发人类创造力。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to discover emergent properties and real user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；要像软件一样每日迭代发布，才能发现涌现能力与真实用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; natural language is the future interface, but AI should render its own UI.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；自然语言是未来界面，但 AI 应渲染自己的 UI。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大化加速。

turley.en: Retention is the north star, driven by friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 留存是北极星，由减少摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进共同驱动。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models must be seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富含可供性的产品；推理模型必须无缝产品化。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; it grounds knowledge and reduces hallucinations, and embodied worlds provide infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：具身能为知识提供现实根基、减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with RL for low-level control and LLMs for high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习负责低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular approaches; research taste is learned through PhD pain.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单、优雅、端到端的方案比复杂的模块化方案更具可扩展性；研究品味来自博士阶段的痛苦磨炼。

jimfan.en: The data problem is now the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他的判断深化为：数据问题已成为机器人领域的核心瓶颈；来自仿真与世界模型的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: The physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away, home use longer.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他提出物理图灵测试——机器人清理凌乱房屋——是终极挑战；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来，家庭使用则更晚。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability, like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为延伸人类能力的工具，像显微镜和望远镜；并认为把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体（如 Gato）是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn like humans.
nando.zh: 同年他强调，像 YouTube 这样的视频学习能让智能体绕开昂贵的强化学习，机器人应像人类一样从视频中学习，而非只依赖遥操作数据。

nando.en: Large models excite but are not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and learning to learn now shows in few-shot prompting.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为大模型令人兴奋但并非全部，根本性创新可以来自任何地方；当年“学会学习”的设想，如今已体现在大模型的少样本提示中。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we don't yet have solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心明显转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，直言这是当今最大挑战，而且我们还没有解决方案——相比 2023 年对能力扩展的乐观，这是一次立场深化。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogged legacy issues, and local-language models can revolutionize education.
nando.zh: 同期他把视野落到非洲：非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而跨越了历史遗留问题，本地语言模型可以革新教育；最大的障碍是研究者相信自己能申请顶尖机构。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“入职”问题并大幅提升模型智能，而微调可能逐渐过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis, with no ceiling for intellectual complexity.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调语言模型上的强化学习开辟了新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，智力复杂度没有直接上限。

sholto.en: Agents' bottleneck is reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能体的瓶颈是随时间跨度的可靠性而非原始能力，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI; Transformers are enough, no new architecture needed.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断预训练加强化学习可能足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），Transformer 已足够，无需全新架构。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil; managing fleets of agents matters more than raw intelligence for now.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为算力是新石油，当前管理智能体集群比原始智能更重要，软件正转型为 API。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码以建立共情、加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, and chase ROI on what to perfect.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地主张不要在交互设计上创新，应复用熟悉模式，并只对高回报的部分追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness over perfection: ship fast, iterate, and empower designers with ownership.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，一以贯之的主线是速度与决断优先于完美：快速发布、迭代，并赋予设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计深化为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool, so invest early.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出人们加入的是品牌而非公司；品牌叙事是招聘工具，因此要尽早投入。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not yield common sense; better inference algorithms and high-quality data can let smaller models outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她质疑单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）能否解决常识问题，认为更好的推理算法与高质量数据能让更小的模型在特定任务上超越大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training via next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe, pleasant responses.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她指出以 下一个词预测 为目标的 预训练 与人类学习根本错位，而用 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF） 做 后训练 才是安全、友好回应的关键。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge, not transcend it. Open research and abductive reasoning are key.
yejin.zh: 到 2025 年，她把数据视为根本瓶颈，认为当前方法只是在插值人类知识而非超越它，并强调开放研究与溯因推理对科学发现的重要性。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; pluralistic alignment beats debiasing the internet; RL during pre-training boosts reasoning.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，她主张小语言模型借助多样化的合成数据也能强大，多元对齐 优于试图给互联网去偏，并认为在 预训练 阶段引入 强化学习 能提升推理能力。

yejin.en: A consistent thread: language is the best medium for reasoning, and AI safety requires teaching moral norms despite value pluralism.
yejin.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：语言是推理的最佳媒介，而 AI 安全必须教会模型道德规范，尽管价值多元让这成为一个棘手的计算问题。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner, and design and engineering are merging.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创作伙伴，设计与工程正在融合。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：它会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles maximize learning over rigid process.
nadchishtie.zh: 快速、粗糙的实验与短迭代周期比僵化流程更能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers beat 8-10 person cross-functional squads; AI use is now expected.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师与工程师的小团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小组；使用 AI 如今已是基本要求。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills in ML and critical thinking.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待探索，人才缺口大于资金缺口，建议通过机器学习和批判性思维积累技能。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research to align next-gen models.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment; third-party testing and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，认为仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题，呼吁第三方测试和监管。

leike.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; measure progress now to reduce uncertainty about alignment.
leike.zh: 始终，他强调对齐方法的实证测试至关重要，通过当下测量进展来减少对齐的不确定性。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测的进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不真正好用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心；自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding, and frontier models struggle with bug finding due to missing training data and poor calibration.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他一贯认为基准测试无法代表真实编程，前沿模型因缺乏训练数据、校准不佳而难以发现 bug。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年他进一步深化：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终掌握主导权；品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎细致更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor; the AI shift will outlast the internet and take decades, and the IDE market is far bigger.
truell.zh: 2025 年他立场转变：原本没料到要做自研模型，如今 Cursor 每个惊艳时刻都离不开定制模型；AI 变革比互联网更深远、需数十年，IDE 市场也大得多。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, yet internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen uses emerge, but big tech safety caution slows launches and engagement-only optimization is misguided.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，最佳用途常出乎创造者意料；但大公司因安全顾虑拖慢发布，且只优化用户参与度并不可取。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他深化判断：推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他进一步认为测试时算力推动进步但不足以单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力与强化学习至关重要，而 AGI 被低估。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, with hierarchical reasoning still missing in RL.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人要同时突破硬件与软件：自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是关键，但强化学习仍缺乏分层推理来完成长程信用分配。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded into networks.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年，他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习大幅提升样本效率，并主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进神经网络。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding.
abbeel.zh: 同年他提出预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移到图像分类、蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务，显示对预训练迁移能力的深化。

abbeel.en: Real-world value demands extreme reliability, like 99.9% in warehouse robotics, and a single network generalizing across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：真实世界价值要求极高可靠性（如仓储机器人 99.9%），并让单一网络跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

abbeel.en: The human brain's generality inspires AI, yet current AI remains far less general; curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real environments.
abbeel.zh: 另一条主线是：人脑的通用性启发 AI，但当前 AI 远不够通用，且好奇心驱动的探索在开放真实环境中会失效。
